title: cressa cretica var. truxillensis
intro: Cressa cretica var. truxillensis, commonly known as "Truxillo cress" or "Truxillo false bugloss", is a plant species within the family Convolvulaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Cressa cretica var. truxillensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
